name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €84.9/MWh on 27 Nov, above the €70 Alert line and 22% higher over three months
state: Dutch TTF gas settled near €84.9/MWh on 27 Nov, 4.1% lower on the week but 21.6% higher over three months, above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). It is about 18% below its 52-week high near €104. Gulf LNG flows remain exposed to Iranian attacks on shipping around Hormuz, which Bloomberg reported intensifying in November (gCaptain).
for_you: Household energy bills in Europe remain exposed to high wholesale gas prices. In Great Britain, Ofgem's price cap sets what most households pay.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures (TTF=F)
gCaptain — Hormuz tanker traffic rises this month even as attacks increase

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
